summary: Eni S.p.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting weekly treasury share purchases (29 Jun–3 Jul 2026) under a buyback program approved 6 May 2026. The issuer acquired 4,897,905 shares (0.16% of capital) at a weighted average price of €20.4169/share, total consideration ~€100M. Since program start (8 May 2026), 29,691,495 shares (0.98%) repurchased for ~€660M; total holdings after these purchases equal 3.85% of share capital. The buyback is part of a second tranche aimed at providing additional shareholder remuneration beyond dividends. No advisory or board recommendation is mentioned. The mechanics are standard open-market purchases on Euronext Milan, governed by shareholder authorization. Watch for continued execution pace and potential impact on share price and EPS; risk-arb is minimal as this is an issuer buyback, not a tender offer.
